Image 2 is STYLE reference only: painterly animated-film pond, translucent jade-turquoise water, brush-textured rounded stones with warm sunlit tops, cool shaded sides, dark damp waterlines, soft submerged sand and restrained water light. Transform image 1 from flat vector coloring into that richer hand-painted style. Preserve EVERY stone and EVERY lily pad exact normalized position, outline, size, and cut-out notch; preserve shoreline shape and strict top-down camera, no perspective horizon. All leaf green-yellow colors retained for foreground extraction. Add fine painterly stone mineral and leaf vein details, warm sand shallow margins, deep cool quiet water middle, gently broken natural color gradients. Keep image sharp, high-detail at 2K, no lens blur. Do NOT add fish, animals, flowers, foliage in foreground, text, UI, or extra stones/leaves. Do NOT copy clock or scene composition from image 2. Do not bake bright caustic stripes or prominent ripples: animated water will be overlaid in game. Full opaque background. Preserve overall original composition with open central water.

Keep EXACT 2 columns x3 rows equal grid and exact existing silhouette sizes, fish center and orientation: all HEAD RIGHT, TAIL LEFT, strictly overhead view with both eyes visible, no side-view fish. Cells same positions as image1: row1 orange goldfish / orange-white clownfish, row2 golden goldfish / blue yellow-finned fish, row3 red-white goldfish / warm orange-white clownfish. Use case: style-transfer. Image1 EDIT TARGET exact geometry winter pond map; image2 STYLE reference of same pond after painterly upgrade.
